changelog:
  exclude:
    labels:
      - release
  categories:   
    - title: New Features 🎉
      labels:
        - enhancement
    - title: Bug Fixes 🐞
      labels:
        - bug
    - title: Technical Debt ⚰️
      labels:
        - technical debt
    - title: Infrastructure 🧱
      labels:
        - infrastructure
    - title: Dependencies ⬆️
      labels:
        - dependencies
    - title: Other Changes
      labels:
        - "*"
